industry_name: US logistics and freight service firms
jurisdiction: United States research pilot; carrier, safety, hours-of-service, privacy, contract and state requirements require qualified owner review.
source_frame: Action Model system-map industry slug logistics_freight; taxonomy reference only, not client demand or implementation proof.
scope_note: Supervised coordination of freight-service records, dispatch communications, shipment status and billing evidence. This record does not perform customs, regulated routing, carrier-authority or safety decisions.
summary: Start with load-intake completeness, dispatch packet coordination, shipment exception follow-up and proof-of-delivery billing reconciliation. Compare matched work against the incumbent TMS or dispatch process; keep carrier selection, hours-of-service, routing, claims and customer commitments with authorized humans.

automation_research.finding: 49 CFR Part 395 establishes hours-of-service and recordkeeping requirements that bound any dispatch assistant. Vendor pages show workflow capabilities, not an automation rate, adoption prevalence or achieved savings; regulated and commercial authority remains human.
automation_research.forecast_note: No independently verified percentage is used; regulation and vendor capability pages do not establish automation or savings forecasts.

processes.process: Customer load-intake and shipment-record completeness review
processes.automation_boundary: Capture requested pickup, delivery, commodity, equipment and contact fields; flag missing or contradictory fields for review. Do not quote binding terms, classify regulated goods or accept a shipment without authorized review.
processes.baseline_required: Matched load volume, intake and correction minutes, incomplete-field and duplicate rates, exception escalations, privacy incidents and actual operating cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accepted complete load record including review, rework and exception handling; missed-critical-field rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if unsafe or regulated details are silently accepted, correction/rework rises, critical fields are missed or private data crosses an unauthorized boundary.
processes.human_authority: Authorized operations staff determine acceptance, terms, commodity treatment and customer commitments; qualified safety and compliance personnel retain authority.

processes.process: Dispatch packet preparation and driver/carrier confirmation
processes.automation_boundary: Assemble approved load details, contact records and timestamps; draft confirmation requests and surface missing acknowledgements. Do not select carriers, assign unsafe work, alter hours-of-service records or issue binding instructions without human approval.
processes.baseline_required: Matched dispatches, packet-preparation and review minutes, acknowledgement latency, correction/reissue count, HOS-related exception count and communication cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurately acknowledged dispatch packet including review and rework; missing-acknowledgement and unsafe-instruction rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if an acknowledgement is mistaken for legal or safety clearance, HOS records are changed or obscured, rework offsets time saved, or an unapproved instruction is sent.
processes.human_authority: Dispatcher and designated carrier/safety authority approve assignment, instructions, records and escalations; the system is not a carrier-authority substitute.

processes.process: Shipment-status exception detection and approved follow-up
processes.automation_boundary: Normalize status events, flag stale or contradictory milestones and draft follow-ups to verified recipients. Do not infer fault, promise delivery, change routing or send customer claims responses without human review.
processes.baseline_required: Matched shipments, exception detection precision, response latency, review/rework minutes, duplicate/wrong-recipient sends, claims escalations and actual communication cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurately triaged and approved exception; stale-event, duplicate-send, missed-escalation and privacy-error rates
processes.falsifier: Reject if stale or incorrect status causes a customer commitment, routing or claims error, review/rework is not reduced, or an escalation is missed.
processes.human_authority: Operations lead approves status interpretation, customer commitments, routing changes and claims/escalations; verified recipients and channel controls remain mandatory.

processes.automation_boundary: Match approved delivery events, signed or electronic proof, accessorial evidence and invoice fields; surface mismatches for review. Do not approve payment, waive claims, alter invoices or determine contractual liability.
processes.baseline_required: Matched invoice volume, reconciliation and rework minutes, mismatch precision/recall, duplicate-payment and dispute counts, review latency and actual processing cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per correctly reconciled invoice packet including exception review; false-match, missed-mismatch and duplicate-payment rates
processes.falsifier: Reject if a mismatch is silently accepted, payment or claim authority is bypassed, false matches/rework rise, or evidence is unavailable for audit.
processes.human_authority: Authorized finance and operations staff approve invoices, accessorials, claims and contractual interpretations; the workflow only organizes evidence.

observed_business_value.reason: No firm baseline, achieved automation rate, review/rework data, operating cost, displacement proof or eligible-population measurement. Null is not zero.

pilot.design: Within one authorized freight operator, compare matched redacted or synthetic loads, dispatches, exceptions and invoice packets under the incumbent and supervised candidate workflows; pre-register HOS, privacy, approval and rollback gates.
record: critical errors, missed escalations and unauthorized-access cases
reject_if: Human time including review/rework is not lower than matched baseline.
Any HOS, carrier-authority, routing, payment or customer commitment action occurs without authorized human approval.
Private shipment, driver or customer data crosses an unauthorized boundary or a critical exception is missed.
Measured first-year net cash is not positive for a cash-savings offer; capacity gains alone are not cash.

limitations: This is not transportation, safety, customs, legal, regulatory or carrier-authority advice, product admission or an industry-wide forecast.
Current software adoption prevalence and subscription prices were not verified; named offerings are not assumed installed.
No generic repository is claimed to replace a TMS, WMS, carrier records, HOS records, contractual authority or professional judgment.
Rights, security, retention, restoration, integrations, accessibility, data quality, claims handling and state/local requirements remain product-owner gates.
